description: This is the entry point JavaScript file for a React application. It renders the main App component into the DOM using ReactDOM's createRoot and render methods, and wraps the application in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
